us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Mississippi elects Democrat Scott Colom to U.S. Senate
bullets: AP called the race for Democrat Scott Colom.
He defeated Republican Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith.
Colom becomes Mississippi’s first Black U.S. senator since Reconstruction.

articles.title: Brooklyn building collapse kills at least two
bullets: A three-story Brooklyn building collapsed near a construction site.
At least two people were killed, officials said.
Seventeen people were hospitalized, including four critically injured.

articles.title: Republican senators complicate Trump judicial confirmations
bullets: Several GOP senators are resisting some late-term judicial nominees.
The dispute threatens a White House push on federal courts.
Senators cited process concerns and specific nominee objections.

articles.title: U.S. jobless claims rise to 200,000 but stay historically low
bullets: Initial unemployment claims ticked up to 200,000.
AP reported layoffs remain rare by historical standards.
The labor market continues showing unusual worker job security.

articles.title: House Republican files impeachment resolution against Defense Secretary Hegseth
bullets: Rep. Thomas Massie filed a resolution targeting Pete Hegseth.
Massie alleged unconstitutional military actions and civilian-harm issues.
Hegseth dismissed the effort as political, according to reports.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Top worldwide stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: U.S. envoys meet Putin after Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi
bullets: Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner met Vladimir Putin in Moscow.
The meeting followed U.S.-mediated Russia-Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi.
Those talks were the first direct Moscow-Kyiv discussions in nine months.

articles.title: Russia and Ukraine agree to large prisoner exchange
bullets: AP reported agreement during U.S.-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi.
The talks involved representatives from Moscow and Kyiv.
The exchange emerged amid stalled broader peace efforts.

articles.title: Israel faces post-election crisis over Netanyahu allegations
bullets: The Atlantic reported turmoil after Israel’s election.
Reports cited allegations involving Netanyahu’s chief of staff.
The controversy centers on claims of manufactured pre-election headlines.

articles.title: European schools face renewed bomb-threat wave
bullets: Thousands of Italian schools received bomb warnings by email.
Some schools received new threats on November 12.
Reuters could not establish the sender’s identity, according to summaries.
articles.source: Reuters / Sky News / RTÉ via Wikipedia summary

articles.title: UK sanctions Russia’s top oil producers
bullets: Reports said Britain sanctioned Russia’s top ten oil producers.
The move targets Moscow’s energy revenue base.
It comes amid continuing pressure over Russia’s war in Ukraine.

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Top India stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Two missing Special Police Officers found dead in J&K’s Kishtwar
bullets: Indian Express reported the deaths in Jammu and Kashmir’s Kishtwar.
The officers had previously been reported missing.
The update led its India live news coverage.

articles.title: Smog blankets Delhi as AQI settles at 307
bullets: Delhi’s air quality remained in the very poor range.
Indian Express reported an AQI reading of 307.
Pollution and weather updates dominated India coverage.

articles.title: Cabinet clears higher rabi fertiliser subsidy
bullets: India approved a rabi fertiliser subsidy of Rs 62,370 crore.
The subsidy is up 64% from last year.
The move exceeds earlier Budget estimates, according to headline summaries.
articles.source: The Hindu / Indian Express via NEXT IAS

articles.title: Telangana to begin first phase of Musi River rejuvenation
bullets: Chief Minister Revanth Reddy announced the first-phase plan.
The project concerns rejuvenation of the Musi River.
ABP listed it among November 12 top India headlines.

articles.title: Cleanliness drive reaches over 12 lakh field institutions
bullets: A ministry update cited cleanliness work across field institutions.
ABP reported the figure exceeded 12 lakh institutions.
The item was listed among national headlines.

stocks.label: US Stocks
stocks.subtitle: Top U.S. market movers from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Nvidia tumbles as CEO controversy deepens
bullets: Nvidia shares fell sharply in early Thursday trading.
Reports questioned CEO Jensen Huang’s future at the company.
The stock had already faced AI-bubble and governance pressure.

articles.title: Micron jumps in AI-led rebound
bullets: Micron was among major market-cap movers Wednesday.
Investing.com reported the stock rallied intraday.
The move came during a broader AI-stock rebound.

articles.title: Oracle rallies as tech shares rebound
bullets: Oracle ranked among major stock movers Wednesday.
The stock rallied during an AI-led market recovery.
Investing.com cited significant intraday market-cap movement.

articles.title: Arm surges more than 12% during Wednesday trading
bullets: Arm gained 12.81%, according to market-mover data.
The move came amid renewed demand for AI-related equities.
The report grouped Arm with other large market-cap movers.

articles.title: Bloom Energy rebounds sharply after selloff
bullets: Bloom Energy rose about 13% in market summaries.
The move followed a steep prior selloff.
AI-infrastructure and energy names led parts of the rebound.

business.label: Business
business.subtitle: Top corporate stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Burberry reports stronger-than-expected second-quarter sales
bullets: Burberry posted comparable retail sales above market estimates.
Growth in the U.S. and China helped offset regional weakness.
Reuters reported weakness in Europe and the Middle East.

articles.title: Eli Lilly weight-loss pill approved in China
bullets: Eli Lilly became first drugmaker with GLP-1 pill approval in China.
The approval covers a weight-loss drug, according to Reuters summaries.
The milestone expands Lilly’s obesity-drug footprint.

articles.title: Thomson Reuters announces $500 million share buyback plan
bullets: Thomson Reuters announced a new normal-course issuer bid.
The company plans repurchases of up to $500 million.
The program runs from November 13, 2026 to November 12, 2027.

articles.title: CoreWeave revenue more than doubles amid AI demand
bullets: CoreWeave reported revenue of $3.7 billion.
CNBC cited CEO Michael Intrator saying AI demand remains overwhelming.
Shares jumped after the report, according to market coverage.

articles.title: Nvidia scandal becomes major corporate-governance risk
bullets: Reports tied Nvidia’s turmoil to CEO conduct allegations.
The controversy raised governance questions at the AI-chip leader.
Nvidia and MegaSpeed denied diversion-related allegations.

tech.label: Tech
tech.subtitle: Top technology stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Trump authorized multiple crackdowns on Nvidia chip diversion, Axios reports
bullets: Axios said Trump approved three crackdowns this year.
The actions targeted suspected diversion of Nvidia AI chips to China.
The report cited Oval Office tensions over enforcement.

articles.title: Huawei unveils AI supercluster architecture
bullets: Huawei described architecture linking up to one million AI chips.
The design aims to make chips operate as one computer.
AP-linked reporting cited Huawei executives and engineers in China.

articles.title: British AI-chip startup Fractile raises $720 million
bullets: Fractile announced a $720 million Series C round.
Reuters reported an approximately $7 billion valuation.
UK government-linked funds supported the financing.

articles.title: Meta expands AI age-estimation tools globally on Instagram
bullets: Meta plans broader AI age-estimation deployment.
The system can move teens into protected account settings.
The expansion comes amid lawsuits over youth-platform harms.

articles.title: Malaysia seized AI-chip servers in export-control case
bullets: Malaysia seized 30 servers with advanced AI chips.
Officials suspected an export-control violation.
The shipment was valued around $12.2 million.
